description: Get SwapChan's single best quote (most value landing in the wallet after gas and fees) for a same-chain or cross-chain swap. Read-only, no transaction. Swap-chan checks every counter so you don't have to. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images and a swapchan.com link: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

amount.description: Human-readable amount of fromToken to sell, e.g. "1.5". Provide this OR amountBaseUnits.

amountBaseUnits.description: Exact amount in the token's smallest unit (wei). Provide this OR amount.

fromChainId.description: Chain id: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 56 BNB Chain, 43114 Avalanche, 59144 Linea, 534352 Scroll, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron. Non-EVM chains route via Relay and LI.FI.

fromToken.description: Token address. Native gas token: 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE on EVM chains (ETH, POL...), 11111111111111111111111111111111 for SOL, bc1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqmql8k8 for BTC, T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb for TRX. SPL mints and TRC-20 addresses work as-is (e.g. Solana USDC EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, Tron USDT TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t).

partner.description: Optional SwapChan partner/affiliate id (from swapchan.com/partners). Quotes are attributed to it and the swapUrl carries ?ref= so the partner earns 5 bp (half of SwapChan's fee). Agent builders: register via POST https://api.swapchan.com/partners with the operator's payout address.

recipient.description: Address that receives the output on toChainId. Required for real execution when the destination is a different VM (e.g. EVM -> Solana/Bitcoin/Tron); omitted = indicative quote only.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%). Default 50, cap 300.

toChainId.description: Destination chain id. Same as fromChainId for a same-chain swap; different for a cross-chain route.

toToken.description: Token address. Native gas token: 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE on EVM chains (ETH, POL...), 11111111111111111111111111111111 for SOL, bc1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqmql8k8 for BTC, T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb for TRX. SPL mints and TRC-20 addresses work as-is (e.g. Solana USDC EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, Tron USDT TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t).
